summary.text: LaVeta Davenport is the Green Party nominee for Michigan's 1st District, advancing from the Green Party convention on July 18, 2026. According to Ballotpedia, she is the founder of a nonprofit organization.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Davenport as the founder of Levadeh, a nonprofit organization that focuses on health, education, relationship and ownership.
In an October 2026 WCMU interview, she said the nonprofit she runs works to improve quality of life in the community.
